original_test_intent: Verify the shared NIC/NC-SI BMC path preserves intended identity and configuration across connected, disconnected and reconnected cable states and reports the NC-SI address in POST.
original_method: Bind the exact shared port and BMC MAC/channel, baseline connected state, have an operator remove and reconnect only that cable, and compare authenticated network, link, reachability, DHCP/static and POST evidence in each state.
manual_activity: An operator identifies, photographs, removes and reconnects the exact shared cable and captures POST while the owner protects alternate management/recovery access.
required_inputs: Exact cable, BMC MAC, LAN channel and bounded-channel meaning
Approved DHCP/static behavior in each state
safety_requirements: Stop on wrong cable, identity drift or host disruption
Do not repeat cable toggles automatically
agent_execution_scope: Guide but do not perform cable actions
Correlate DHCP/static and POST NC-SI display
Compare events without physical autonomy or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only a partial connected-state inventory; it assumes an endpoint, skips trust validation and cannot exercise cable or POST coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use authenticated Web UI/IPMI/Redfish readback synchronized with operator-controlled connected/removed/reconnected states and POST capture.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Three cable scenarios, same IP/MAC, DHCP/static display, NC-SI POST, script and 5/5 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a topology-bound connected-remove-reconnect comparison with independent recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable identity, state timing and authenticated/POST evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One JSON listing omits both physical transitions and NC-SI POST display.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removing the shared path may interrupt BMC and host sideband connectivity.

project_override_considerations: Project failover behavior must be explicitly documented; loss on the shared path cannot be called failure if an approved alternate path is the intended design, nor vice versa.
expected_evidence: Approval, topology, exact port/cable and BMC MAC/channel baseline
Operator/photo timestamps for three cable states
BMC/host/network events, recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently defines shared-NIC three-state coverage; details are project readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Expands a single insecure read into the actual three-state physical shared-NIC and POST NC-SI validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case cannot be reduced to link-up at one instant: cable removal and restoration are the stimulus, while identity/configuration continuity and POST NC-SI display are separate required oracles. Physical action stays human-owned; evidence comparison is automatable.
